name: How long does an accessible bathroom remodel typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessible bathroom remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical disability bathroom remodel usually takes between one to three weeks depending on structural scope. Simple projects like installing wall blocking and reinforced fixtures wrap up in a couple of days. Larger jobs—such as demoing a tub, re-framing to widen the door, pouring a zero-threshold shower pan, and installing non-slip tile—require more time for proper curing, waterproofing, and trade coordination. As an owner-operated team, Abraham Becerra directly leads the framing, drywall, and finish carpentry on site, coordinating plumbing adjustments closely to minimize downtime.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most accessible bathroom remodels take one to three weeks, depending on framing needs, plumbing relocations, and tile curing times.
